outcome: duration of the first and second stage of labor
duration of the third stage of delivery
need for pharmacological stimulation (augmentation) of labor
cohort: 101 low-risk women who had water births and 60 low-risk women who had regular childbirths
finding: Water birth does not increase the risk for mother and neonate in low-risk women.
mod_finding: Women in the water birth group had a prolonged third stage of delivery, lesser need for pharmacological stimulation (augmentation) of labor, notably lower use of analgesics, lower occurrence of birth injuries, shorter in-patient time, and more frequent bonding.
